name: Registrable Service
description: Escape hatch for hook-registering classes that don't fit a specific abstract. Generates a class implementing the Registrable interface from rtcamp/wp-framework with an empty register_hooks() body.

inputs.description: PSR-4 namespace for the service class. Default 'Inc\Services' matches the rtCamp skeleton.
Directory for the service file. Default 'includes/Services'.
PSR-4 namespace for the test class. Default 'Inc\Tests\Services'.
Directory for the test file. Default 'tests/Services'.

wiring.description: Add the class to a Services (or domain-specific) module so the framework Loader instantiates it and calls register_hooks(). If no suitable module exists, scaffold one first via `wp-tooling add wp/module --name=Services --kind=registrable`.
